beats.headline: Summoned, and a demon eviction starts
beats.text: Nobody said my name. The fighting in Reaver territory added up to it on its own, which is how I am usually called for, and so I come. The moment I set foot in the realm a demon eviction begins, the way weather begins. I did not do that. It is simply what happens when I am in a room. Now then. Let me see who is here, and what they think they are fighting for.

beats.headline: The Ceremony of Chaos
beats.text: Meatus will not let me leave this place, so I call the Ceremony of Chaos. Everyone standing outside a roof goes still, eyes white, invulnerable, a witness. Nearly everyone. The Viceroys have been hammering Carl's mind, and it has tipped his Mind Balance into a sixteenth level, so he stays awake in the middle of my stillness. Then I bring the witnesses forth, and up they go, thousands of them, into one great pile beside the Dream castle. I can do this once. Ever.

beats.headline: Free, and full of news
beats.text: Carl's spinner lands on the Pied Piper, and the world is still frozen when I put my hand on his shoulder, at his own height. I am free. My sponsor is gone, my pilot is dead, and it is delicious. I bite his ear. Donut has just been named champion, and I can make him one too; he only has to kill three gods, grumpy Emberus among them. I snap his pinkie, to help with the curse from Meatus. Then the news: the War Mages traded the Gate of the Feral Gods to a merchant named Paca, who keeps it in her stomach. And Britney is possessed.

beats.headline: A costume, he asks
beats.text: A waystation called Squirties, just outside the tunnel to the Earth system, where the pet toys do not sell. The saccathian at the counter half recognises me. He calls it a fantastic costume. Or surgery. Then he asks if I have come to the gate to pay my respects to Nami. Are you asking Eris, goddess of chaos, if she is wearing a costume? Yes, he says. I laugh. I snap my fingers, and every tentacle on his face goes rigid and starts spewing a different liquid. Some of it burns.

beats.headline: The five-sided coin
beats.text: I stop the street, all but Carl, and he says he did not summon me. He thought of me. That is the same thing. I ask for three things: make nice with Akuma, worship me truly when I say so, and let me score his surface a little before I paint it. Then the coin. Donut, RIP. Carl, de-feeted. Most of my friends are dead. I become what they accuse me of. He snatches it out of the air before it lands. The fifth side. Chaos wins again.

beats.headline: Every inventory swaps at once
beats.text: Everyone holding something: hold out your hands. My Scavenger's Daughter effect goes off and every crawler here is carrying whatever the crawler nearest them was carrying. Donut gets Carl's. Carl does not blink. He asks her to put a bomb together with an enhanced pet biscuit, as though he had been waiting years for someone else to have his pockets. I adore him for it. I no longer need him to worship me, and I tell him so. Every exit is an entrance. I am leaving through one now.
